meta.name: meta-ads-audit
meta.description: Meta Ads (Facebook + Instagram) account audit and business context setup. Run this first — it gathers business information, analyzes account health, and saves context that all other Meta ads skills reuse. Trigger on "audit my Meta ads", "audit my Facebook ads", "Meta ads audit", "set up my Meta ads", "onboard Meta", "Meta account overview", "how's my Meta account", "Meta health check", "what should I fix in my Facebook ads", or when the user is new to NotFair Meta and hasn't run an audit before. Also trigger proactively when other Meta ads skills detect that meta business-context.json is missing.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会先收集你的 Meta 广告账户信息，分析账户健康度，并保存业务背景文件。它只诊断不修改，所有修复建议都通过另一个技能执行。
howto.when: 当你提到“审计我的 Meta 广告”、“审计我的 Facebook 广告”、“Meta 账户概览”等关键词，或者你是新用户且未运行过审计时触发。其他 Meta 技能检测到缺少业务背景文件时也会主动触发。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will first gather your Meta ads account info, analyze account health, and save business context files. It diagnoses only, never mutates; all fix recommendations are routed through another skill.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say "audit my Meta ads", "audit my Facebook ads", "Meta account overview", etc., or when you are a new user who hasn't run an audit. Also triggered proactively when other Meta skills detect missing business context file.
